# Weight Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A record of current weight.

## Scope note

- Stepping on a weight scale, and logging the weight displayed.
- If an Bluetooth-enable scale, capture the current weight reading.

## Broader

- [Health Event](../HealthEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
